scripts.test: npm run test:utils && npm run test:static
scripts.test:rules: npm run test:rules:rtdb && npm run test:rules:firestore
scripts.test:rules:rtdb: npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only database,auth --project demo-hissez "node scripts/test-firebase-rules.mjs"
scripts.test:rules:firestore: npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-hissez "node scripts/test-firestore-rules.mjs"
scripts.test:migration: npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only database,firestore --project demo-hissez "node scripts/test-firestore-migration.mjs"
